description: Classic voice-over bed: music is ducked under the dialogue with a look-free sidechain (threshold 0.02, ratio 6, attack 20 ms, release 400 ms) and the master is normalised two-pass with ffmpeg loudnorm to -14 LUFS, -1.5 dBTP and LRA 11. Note: the same listener rejected always-on ducking for a narrative film ('interrupting the music'), but it suits ads and explainers.
